name: Zibeon
overview: Zibeon is identified in Scripture as a notable figure among the Horites and Hivites, specifically as a son of Seir the Horite who inhabited the land (Genesis 36:20, 1 Chronicles 1:38). He is also described as the father of Anah, who discovered mules in the wilderness while tending Zibeon's asses (Genesis 36:24). Additionally, Zibeon's lineage is connected to Esau through Aholibamah, his granddaughter, who bore Esau three sons (Genesis 36:2, 14). These passages highlight Zibeon's place within the genealogies that link the Horite and Hivite peoples to the broader narrative of Israel's neighbors and Esau's family.
